AUTH_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: required positive integer; no approved default/range.
ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL: required positive parsed duration, less than idle timeout,
retaining the architectural one-day access-token ceiling.
strictly below idle timeout and at most idleTimeoutSeconds / 2.
Refuse startup on invalid required configuration.
SESSION_RETENTION_SECONDS: positive integer, proposed 604800; GDPR decision OPEN.
New configuration affects new sessions and still-valid sessions
on their next activity-driven renewal, never expired sessions.
